description: SEC Form 144 insider sale notices — Planned insider sales (Rule 144 notices) from SEC EDGAR. Company mode: ticker= or cik=, optional days= (default 90, max 365), limit= (max 20). Market screen (no company): days= (default 2, max 7), limit= (max 15), min_value= - the latest notices across the market sorted by dollar value. Per notice: seller, relationship (officer/director/10% holder), shares, aggregate market value, % of shares outstanding, approximate sale date, broker, how the shares were acquired, 10b5-1 plan adoption date, sales in the past 3 months. Company mode adds a heuristic signal NONE / NORMAL / ELEVATED / HIGH. Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_form_144
